p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f: data=json.load(f)
for i,t in enumerate(data['texts']):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'outstanding .* common stock|common stock .* outstanding|shares .* outstanding', txt, re.I):
        if 'January' in txt or 'March' in txt or 'April' in txt or 'as of' in txt.lower():
            print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'SIZE',t.get('size'),'LABEL',t.get('label'))
            print(txt[:500].replace('\\n',' '))
            print('---')
PY"
